title: Erdős Problem 1111: Wagon's bound
abstract: Every finite graph with no clique of size t and chromatic number at least C(t,2)+1 has two anticomplete vertex sets that each induce a graph of chromatic number at least 2 (Wagon 1980, as noted by El-Zahar and Erdős). In Erdős Problem 1111, d(t,c) is the least d such that every finite graph with clique number less than t and chromatic number at least d has two anticomplete vertex sets A, B with χ(G[A]) ≥ c and χ(G[B]) ≥ c (El-Zahar and Erdős 1985). So the result says d(t,2) ≤ C(t,2)+1. Two anticomplete sets that each induce a graph of chromatic number at least 2 are the same as an induced 2K₂.
